name: member-row
title: Member row
description: A team member as a list row: avatar, name and email, a role you can change, a status that includes pending invites, and a menu of actions.
docs: Put the rows in a ul. member is { id, name, email, image, role, status, invitedAt, owner } and roles is a list of { value, label, description }. Pass onRoleChange to make the role a select: it receives the new role and the member and may return a promise, in which case the select shows the choice while it runs, goes back and says so if it rejects, and the change is announced ("Sofia Rossi's role is now Admin."). An invited member reads "Invited 3 days ago" with Resend and Revoke in the menu, a suspended one can be restored, owner fixes the role and gives the reason (a tooltip on a wide row with a pointer, plain text on a narrow one and on a touch screen), and isYou adds a You tag and leaves out every destructive action. The menu fits the status unless you pass actions, and onAction reports the choice: Remove and Revoke only report, so confirm them in your own dialog. onRoleChange must update member.role by the time it resolves, because the change is announced then. The row reads its own width: it folds into two lines in a narrow container, and below 26rem the invite words move to a line of their own so the address stays readable. Pass now to get the relative time in server HTML; dates use locale and timeZone.
